TXT_AVA_MAPS_EMPTY: No map is installed. Maps come in mod packages.
TXT_AVA_MAPS_MODE_REFUSED: This mode cannot run on this map:
TXT_AVA_CREDITS_PORT: Project Avalanche is an unofficial port; it needs your own copy of the game.
TXT_AVA_OPTIONS_MENUS_NOTE: Used when you save, and the next time Project Avalanche starts. The original game opens its menus on their first item; Last Item Picked opens them on the item you picked there last.
TXT_AVA_OPTIONS_MOVIES_NOTE: Range Movies change when you save, Boot Movie at the next start. The original game plays a range's video each time you choose the range in World Tour, and its boot video at every start.
TXT_AVA_OPTIONS_NEXT_START: These settings are used the next time Project Avalanche starts.
TXT_AVA_OPTIONS_DISPLAY_NOTE: The window mode and render resolution change when you save. The other settings are used the next time Project Avalanche starts.
TXT_AVA_OPTIONS_NEXT_JOIN: These settings are used from the next server you join: what one server may send you, how much the cache keeps, and whether servers' own scripts run.
TXT_AVA_OPTIONS_RESET_BODY: Reset these settings to their defaults?
TXT_AVA_CREDITS_NOTICES: Their license texts are in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt next to the game.
TXT_AVA_BROWSER_OVER_LIMIT: Joining this server downloads at least %1s MB; your limit is %2s MB (Options, Multiplayer).
TXT_AVA_BROWSER_RESOURCES_NONE: No resources • client mods: %1s • their scripts: %2s
TXT_AVA_BROWSER_EMPTY_INTERNET: The server list has no server of this version right now. Press BACK to ask it again.
TXT_AVA_BROWSER_EMPTY_LAN: No server on your network answered yet (a server answers when its operator turns LAN discovery on). The search goes on while this tab is open.
TXT_AVA_BROWSER_EMPTY_FAVOURITES: No favourites yet. Press Y on a server to keep it here, or START to connect to an address.
TXT_AVA_BROWSER_EMPTY_RECENT: No servers joined yet. Press START to connect to an address.
TXT_AVA_BROWSER_PING_HELP: Ping: the round trip of the server's UDP query (its port + 1) in ms; empty when the server does not answer it.
TXT_AVA_BROWSER_ASKING_LONG: Asking the server for its details...
TXT_AVA_BROWSER_CANNOT_JOIN: This game cannot join this server: %1s.
TXT_AVA_BROWSER_DROP_MISSING: The server's drop %1s is not on this game's disc.
TXT_AVA_BROWSER_FAKE_ENTRY: This is an entry of the fake list (a test option): there is no server to join.
TXT_AVA_BROWSER_NOT_KEPT: No folder for servers.json is known: favourites and recent servers are not kept.
TXT_AVA_BROWSER_BAD_ADDRESS: That is not a server address: %1s.
TXT_AVA_BROWSER_SEARCH_TITLE: Search: name, player:, mode:, drop:, tag:, region:, ~ to leave out
TXT_AVA_BROWSER_NO_MASTER: This build asks no master server, so the Internet list is empty. LAN, Favourites, Recent and START (an address) work without one.
TXT_AVA_BROWSER_MASTER_FAILED: ; the master server did not answer (%1s)
TXT_AVA_BROWSER_LEFT_OUT: ; %1s left out (listed twice, or not readable)
TXT_AVA_BROWSER_BAD_LISTED_KEY: The master listed a key for this server that no server can hold; it is not joined.
TXT_AVA_CONNECTING_HELD_QUIET: The server holds your join while its scripts check it.
TXT_AVA_DOWNLOADING_CHECKING_CONTENT: Comparing your content with the server's
TXT_AVA_LINK_BODY: A link asks Project Avalanche to join the server at %1s. Nothing has been sent to it. Join it?
TXT_AVA_BF_DESCRIPTION: Which servers the list shows, and in which order. Search with R3 on the list.
TXT_AVA_NAME_PROMPT_TITLE: Choose your name for online play
TXT_AVA_NAME_PROMPT_NOTE: Other players see this name on servers and in chat. You can change it later under Options, Player Name.
TXT_AVA_SETTINGS_BROKEN_BODY: %1s could not be read (%2s). Save these settings in a new file? The old file is kept beside it.
TXT_AVA_BEST_NOT_KEPT_FULL: Ridden with gameplay mods, and the save's mod records are full: this run is not kept as your best.
TXT_AVA_BEST_NOT_KEPT_NO_ID: Ridden with gameplay mods, and this event has no content id to record them under: this run is not kept as your best.
TXT_AVA_PLAYERS_FREERIDE: Freeride: no places and no scores (this server's instance rides without a race).
TXT_AVA_PLAYERS_RACE: Race: the finished by their times, then the furthest split and the time there (the server's standings).
TXT_AVA_PLAYERS_TRICK: Trick: by the points (the server's standings; a run's points come at each combo's end).
TXT_AVA_PLAYERS_SURVIVE: Survive: by the distance descended (the server's standings).
TXT_AVA_PLAYERS_PING_HELP: Ping: the round trip of each player's link as the server measures it.
TXT_AVA_ROUND_FINISHED: FINISHED · WAITING FOR THE OTHER RIDERS
TXT_AVA_ROUND_WATCHING_NONE: WATCHING THE ROUND · NO RIDER ON THE SLOPE YET
TXT_AVA_CHAT_OFF: Chat is off on this server
TXT_AVA_CHAT_MODS_OFF: This server switches your mods off: %1s
TXT_AVA_CHAT_MODS_SIM_OFF: This server switches your mods' simulation changes off: %1s
TXT_AVA_CHAT_MUTED: You are muted on this server until %1s
TXT_AVA_CHAT_MUTED_FOREVER: You are muted on this server
TXT_AVA_CHAT_UNSENDABLE: Not sent: a character of the line is not one every player's fonts draw
TXT_AVA_DATA_NO_INDEX: Your game data was set up by an earlier version and has no content index.
TXT_AVA_DATA_NO_MOVIES: Your game data was set up by an earlier version and has no movies and no content index.
TXT_AVA_DATA_INDEX_DAMAGED: The content index of your game data is damaged.
TXT_AVA_DATA_MARKER_DAMAGED: The setup record of your game data is damaged.
TXT_AVA_DATA_UNFINISHED: The setup of your game data has not finished.
TXT_AVA_DATA_MISSING: No game data is set up.
TXT_AVA_DATA_TODO_REPAIR: In the launcher, open Settings, Game Data and choose Repair game data (it reads your SSX disc image again).
TXT_AVA_DATA_TODO_SETUP: In the launcher, open Settings, Game Data and choose Extract game data.
